title: Oathsworn: Into the Deepwood
subtitle: Dark fantasy cooperative boss battler and mystery campaign
tagline: Venture into the Deepwood and face the horrors within
loreSummary: In a world consumed by the Deepwood, the last bastion of humanity relies on the Oathsworn, a company of hardened mercenaries, to fight back the encroaching darkness and monstrous entities.
keyFeatures: Unique combat system with cards or dice

os_extended.name: Extended Campaign (All Encounters)
os_extended.description: Main story and all optional boss encounters.

milestones.title: Beyond the City Bastion
milestones.phase: Deepwood Phase I - The Forest Verge
milestones.description: Leaving the protective wards of Bastone behind to confront the brood horrors infesting the outer woodlands.

milestones.title: The Broodmother's Lair
milestones.phase: Deepwood Phase II - The Fungal Depths
milestones.description: Surviving the claustrophobic labyrinth beneath the trees and discovering who is feeding the Deepwood.

milestones.title: The Heart of Darkness
milestones.phase: Deepwood Phase III - The Colossal Behemoths
milestones.description: Fighting through apex monstrosities guarding the primordial grove as the company's sanity frays.

milestones.title: The Final Stand for Bastone
milestones.phase: Deepwood Phase IV - The Climax of the War
milestones.description: The decisive siege determining whether humanity's last stronghold endures or is consumed by the Deepwood.
